programme.desc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。

programme.title: 狄仁傑之通天謎案
programme.desc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

programme.title: 天之書
programme.desc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密

programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: 開棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。

programme.title: 煞面迷影
programme.desc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英台
programme.desc: 祝英台既為女兒身,卻穿男兒裝上學堂,與同窗梁山伯結下生死之愛。山伯得悉真相後,前往祝家求親,豈料英台已被許配他人,二人被迫分開。山伯傷心欲絕,一病不起。英台驚聞噩耗,哭墳跳進墓裡殉情。

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲
programme.desc: 故事描述,金兵侵入,身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒,保護太上皇玉璽,不斷出計,最終難免決一死戰

programme.title: 痳瘋怪拳
programme.desc: 鐵橋三發覺林縣官與鎮南醫局主持孟平勾結販毒,被追殺,幸得漁家女採嬌所救。採嬌乾爹醉公公介紹鐵到歐陽洪的雜貨店送貨,因而認識酒樓夥計老鼠仔。林與孟查知鐵下落,欲加害鐵,反而使歐陽洪無辜被害。鐵逃入海幢寺,得玄光大師傳授五郎八卦棍,遂與老鼠仔往找孟平報仇…

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

programme.title: 玉面俠
programme.desc: 章臻與月奴相愛卻不被接納,二人被四怪所殺後,留下一對雙胞兒。月奴的姊姊希望挽救其門派的聲望,拆散雙胞,將他們分別送到對立門派收養。十八年後,雙胞胎兒重聚,互相傷殘,亦隨即掀起江湖風風雨雨。

programme.title: 楊貴妃
programme.desc: 唐明皇十分寵愛妃子楊貴妃,導致終日尋歡作樂,荒廢國事,更將所有國事交貴妃之兄丞相楊國忠處理。丞相卻因貪贓枉法,暴虐無道,引起軍民共憤。民眾乘機造反要弒唐明皇,貴妃自知難逃一死,於是最終投繯自盡。

programme.title: 鬼太監
programme.desc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦,朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕,桂竟利用父女之情,假借燕燕之手殺朱锦

programme.title: 武松
programme.desc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。

programme.title: 梅山收七怪
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃,但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間,導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪,否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 後門
programme.desc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。

programme.title: 萬箭穿心
programme.desc: 馬慶庭、向獨步、金梁義結金蘭,專與元軍作對。馬假意歸附元朝,獲封鳳陽鎮威大將軍,向、金火速進城,途中遇少婦沈衣霞,向娶之為妻。金催馬對元人採取行動,馬卻藉詞拖延。後來馬竟與沈有染,馬將向圍殺於城外,並冠以江洋大盜之名。金設計「萬箭穿心」,誓為向報仇……

programme.title: 夕陽戀人
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工,在夕陽萌生感情,後女因識破男的太子爺身份,深感受騙

programme.title: 大盜歌王
programme.desc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正,搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後,他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是,神偷設計捉拿冒認者,最終會否連累自己?

programme.title: 兒女是我們的
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……

programme.title: 毒龍潭
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙,盜去師父的玉龍劍,並生下一子一女;後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭,唐抱子虞江逃走,女青兒則歸師公門下;二十年後,劍再次被盜,青女扮男裝,私下尋劍,卻遇樊舊友天涯客

programme.title: 八道樓子
programme.desc: 1933年,日軍出動兵團兩萬,戰車五十餘輛,進攻「八道樓子」的據點。我軍以寡敵眾,死守「八道樓子」抵禦日軍進攻,血戰五日五夜,終於失守。日軍發現樓內,只有七具血肉模糊的屍體,為之肅然起敬,立碑「支那七勇士」之墓。

programme.title: 八道樓子
programme.desc: 1933年,日軍出動兵團兩萬,戰車五十餘輛,進攻「八道樓子」的據點。我軍以寡敵眾,死守「八道樓子」抵禦日軍進攻,血戰五日五夜,終於失守。日軍發現樓內,只有七具血肉模糊的屍體,為之肅然起敬,立碑「支那七勇士」之墓。

programme.title: 釣金龜
programme.desc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去台北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?

programme.title: 憤怒青年
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。

programme.title: 七煞
programme.desc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」,在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅,並派臥底從內瓦解組織,隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫,幕後壇主可會找出臥底?

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 飛龍斬
programme.desc: 奸相秦權病重,危在旦夕,派手下爭奪長生籐。護衛司馬駿與「九指魔女」沙沙向藥師處取藥被拒,便殺死了藥師。師弟鐵二郎盜走了長生籐,司馬駿追殺鐵二郎,兩人展開了生死決鬥。

programme.title: 阿牛發達記
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴。這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…

programme.title: 五大漢
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾,聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員,前往危險的遠方英國領事館,途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。

programme.title: 千王鬥千霸
programme.desc: 名震賭壇的千王與其拍檔受命調查一位上海賭界大亨,懷疑其以賭場為掩護從事間諜活動。兩人深入危機四伏的賭局世界,在層層布局與試探中步步為營,與強敵展開一場關乎生死與榮耀的鬥智對決。

programme.title: 叉手
programme.desc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織,專殺江湖豪俠,彼等行事,均帶面具,故彼等究為何人,無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等,赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在,擬一舉殲滅該組織,為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭,態度極為神秘,暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 銷魂玉
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意,許下三個願望,雖然願望靈驗之極,結果落得家散人亡;風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死,變成水鬼復仇;豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後,仍不斷在人間走動,盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶,終被蕭雲玉追殺致死

programme.title: 噴火美人魚
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假,忽然聽到新聞報導:一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人,並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時,一個美的女郎破浪而來,身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚,女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突 電影未到最後一分鐘,不知結局。

programme.title: 噴火美人魚
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假,忽然聽到新聞報導:一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人,並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時,一個美的女郎破浪而來,身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚,女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突 電影未到最後一分鐘,不知結局。

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王,李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後,遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥,出千騙財,開設豪華賭場,欲將陳誘得入局…

programme.title: 多咀街
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。

programme.title: 小子有種
programme.desc: 貪官為討好一群西方人,設計攫取鎮中廟宇的寶貴佛像。幸得張德泰醫師及其兒子張小泰二人合力利用中國功夫,先破西洋拳,再敗日本劍道,然後大勝西洋劍,最終才可保住佛像。

programme.title: 花月良宵
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。

programme.title: 少林傳人
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位,率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮;皇帝見大勢已去,命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養,法號道行,習得少林絕技;二太子則易名五子泰,由丞相撫養。多年後,五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」,與道行相遇,卻不知對方正是親兄弟……

programme.title: 鬼屋麗人
programme.desc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸。

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣
programme.desc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈,後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐,並尋出個中玄機

programme.title: 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室

programme.title: 幪面大俠
programme.desc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後,馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後,幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。

programme.title: 貂蟬
programme.desc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。

programme.title: 背叛師門
programme.desc: 高堅是武林大豪石正仲門下小弟子,但因石正仲性格偏執,常不問是非情由就對高堅施以懲罰。一次,高救了師父的仇人金天運,金為報恩將武功授給高,高卻被判「背叛師門」之罪

programme.title: 血手印
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁的女兒訂親,但富翁卻因肇德家道中落,反對婚事。肇德為迎娶其女兒,決定要上京考取功名。上京赴考前,肇德去見未婚妻,怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上,他更被誣陷殺人。究竟包公最後如何為他洗脫冤情?

programme.title: 風花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路

programme.title: 大決鬥
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後,唐人杰毅然承擔罪責,成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下,他終於成功復仇,卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。

programme.title: 愛情不NG
programme.desc: 風頭正勁的影帝鄭直(信飾)受邀聯手急速走紅的女星蘇妮娜(鐘欣桐飾)領銜主演影片《小城往事》。在參演過程中,早已過慣大明星生活的鄭直,對窮小子生活的把握和表現始終得不到好萊塢新晉女導演曼迪?吳(李小冉飾)的滿意。更為糟糕的是,他的表演竟屢被導

programme.title: 摩登澡堂
programme.desc: 從小與父親疏遠的鄭輝,意外穿越回了八十年代,在與年輕時的父親一同經歷了許多事後,慢慢走進了陌生父親的內心,明白了工作之間並無尊卑之分,每個普通人都有著平凡而偉大的夢想。

programme.title: 二子開店
programme.desc: 青年二子待業在家,整天無所事事。哥們麻杆聞得居委會有意讓他們幾個待業青年合夥承包一家小客店,趕來和二子商量。二子覺得這個主意不錯,於是和麻杆開始“招兵買馬,他們找來了失業在家的女生英子、父母都不在了的大虎和不堪忍受繼父虐待的小豆。在二子父

programme.title: 焦裕祿
programme.desc: 該片描寫了縣委書記--焦裕祿同志,在蘭考縣任職期間,抱重病帶領全縣人民群眾戰天鬥地,克己奉公,甘當人民公僕,為改變蘭考面貌,為黨的事業謳心瀝血,鞠躬盡瘁的動人故事。

programme.title: 朱大琴,請與本台聯繫

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 英普
programme.desc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #3
programme.desc: 跟團隊一起度過忙碌的一天,他們釋放已康復的蟒蛇,教穿山甲如何狩獵,並包抄一群長尾猴與夏洛特博士一起尋找失蹤的猛禽,而阿曼達博士則幫助一隻被偷獵者狗隻蹂躪的假面野豬

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #4

programme.title: 仙境森林的秘密 #3 英普

programme.desc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備

programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #5
programme.desc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕

programme.title: 非洲視「野」 #1
programme.desc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: In the remote, ancient villages of southern Anhui Province in southeast China, a breed of merchants emerged, altering and reshaping the face of China’s trade and commerce Cast in to the tumultuous world of business at a tender, early age, these boys turned into some of China’s most successful traders, businessmen and merchants With their legacy firmly secure in their centuries old lavish and opulent houses, and their illustrious careers recorded in the annals of history for posterity, these shrewd astute, and influential merchants helped shape China’s commercial past for centuries Discover China follows in the footsteps of the famous Huizhou Merchants

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Located on the ancient Silk Road, Dunhuang Oasis was the epicenter of an amazing discovery at the turn of the century Taoist monk Wang Yuan Lu, who was appointed to care for a Buddhist holy place, was displeased with his position A fateful sweep of the broom revealed a secret cache of thousands of Buddhist scrolls, unlocking the secrets held within the Sutra Cave Over 50,000 artifacts, murals, statues, idols spanning the history of 12 different Chinese Dynasties were discovered News of the find led to the discovery of the Mogao Grottoes by a British explorer who was surveying the ruins in the area Fascinated by the find, Sir Marc Aurel Stein led the first of several foreign expeditions who bargained with the monk for these priceless artifacts, leaving the Mogao Grottos nearly empty To this day, China is still heart broken at the loss

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Located on the ancient Silk Road, Dunhuang Oasis was the epicenter of an amazing discovery at the turn of the century Taoist monk Wang Yuan Lu, who was appointed to care for a Buddhist holy place, was displeased with his position A fateful sweep of the broom revealed a secret cache of thousands of Buddhist scrolls, unlocking the secrets held within the Sutra Cave Over 50,000 artifacts, murals, statues, idols spanning the history of 12 different Chinese Dynasties were discovered News of the find led to the discovery of the Mogao Grottoes by a British explorer who was surveying the ruins in the area Fascinated by the find, Sir Marc Aurel Stein led the first of several foreign expeditions who bargained with the monk for these priceless artifacts, leaving the Mogao Grottos nearly empty To this day, China is still heart broken at the loss

programme.desc: Looming across northern China, The Great Wall sits atop the crests, ridges and mountain tops, sprawling like a slumbering dragon Through the ages, it has been stormed by marauding Mongolians, hailed as the ultimate defensive wall, and is one of China’s most magnificent accomplishments and first iconic image The Great Wall has witnessed the waxing and waning of numerous dynasties and outcomes of many historic transformations Its secrets of construction are still being uncovered, as well as revealing the stories left behind by those who constructed it The generations, in an age where The Great Wall no longer serves its purpose, enjoys a life peace in a once threatened nation nDiscover China marches across the great wall’s Wartorn Frontiers

programme.title: The Water Dancers
programme.desc: Dragonflies are the sentinels of the Earth Being among the oldest creatures on our planet, they have lived in harmony with the indigenous plants and animals of Earth’s bountiful landscapes for 300 million years We came, we conquered and we evicted them from their habitats Now, after millennia of human recklessness, we are turning back to nature’s messenger, the dragonfly, for promise of a new way forward South Africa’s scientists and industries are working to bring them back into our world through a creative system of connected corridors, known as Ecological Networks The Water Dancers, a name from the Zulu Jigamanzi, “dancing on water,” invites you into the precious world of the small things to discover how their sensitive nature can help us design a passage into the future

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-中華文明起源重溯與聖經創世記的關係

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

高朋滿座#126粵
programme.desc: 根與花鬧翻後寄住朋家中，揚言不肯回家。朋發現根提到有一心願未了，便向花查問，根向朋要求朋助他開辦個人畫展，花利用「贈品」吸引客人，令畫展盛況空前。根滿足地回家，但卻不知眾人為他作出的巨大付出。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 謝危謀反逼宮，皇后姜雪寧自刎於寧安宮內，姜寧不願己作如此結尾，決定讓雪寧帶著記憶重來。雪寧回到尚未入宮之時，重生的她一反常態，用假帳本懲治惡僕討回財物，謝危看在眼裡，驚覺雪寧城府極深，遂派人前往監視。

食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽傳授燒味製法。製作脆皮燒肉，烤前要在豬皮上刺洞；要燒肉變得鹹香，醃時還有秘訣；燒出半肥瘦叉燒，關鍵在一隻叉。「大廚平煮」傳授西班牙海鮮飯配凍湯；海鮮要分段下鍋，生米煮成熟飯要控制火候和時間。

programme.title: 澳門「休」遊攻略粵
programme.desc: 喜歡前往澳門遊玩，但卻懶得規劃行程？相關巴士資訊網頁、澳門旅遊吉祥物「麥麥」帶路，讓「仙氣」女主持Rosita(郭柏妍)、游游(游嘉欣)輕鬆發掘當地的吃喝玩樂熱點，要「躺平」遊澳門，無問題！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 智慧齒並非人人都有四隻，部份人甚至完全沒有。牙科醫生提醒，如智慧齒發炎就要正視，否則可能引致呼吸困難，甚至危及生命。牙醫亦詳述拔除智慧齒的微創手術步驟，也提到某些患者或不適合接受這類手術。玫瑰痤瘡眼是一種乾眼症，發病多與「毛囊蠕形蟎」的寄生蟲有關。眼科醫生指這病會導致反覆出現眼瘡，情況如嚴重更可令視力下降。除了治療詳情外，醫生亦帶來預防建議。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「香葉肉碎淮山豆炒米形粉」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 乙型肝炎有機會引致肝癌，不容忽視。肝癌康復者親訴抗癌經歷；專科醫生細說相關資訊，並介紹局部熱力射頻消融術的治療方案。肝病的早期徵狀不明顯，定期檢測才能夠早知早醫，醫生詳析釋檢查方法。透過磁力共振配顯影劑，可有效確診肝癌，詳情如何？縱然發現時肝癌已屬晚期，醫生亦有可康復病例。如有中央肥胖情況，會較易出現可引發嚴重肝病的脂肪肝，何謂安全的腰圍標準？此外，運動學者雷雄德指導主持「超慢跑」，有助消脂保健。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚收到高哲傳真，明示其目標是「宇宙之星」。運送車停在隧道內，明翔化身交通警偷天換日，卻被警方撞破。蓉蓉向高哲訴苦怕被開除；翌日高哲與眾人找蓉蓉買基金。君豪藉着搞首飾展，以宣傳新入股的利星銀行，之後作慈善拍賣，實打算監守自盜騙保險費，而負責保安的是江翹的公司。江翹約譚彬看電影，主角明翔在現場揭發譚彬竟和江翹約會。高哲要明翔和譚彬調查江翹公司的保安系統，明翔發現君豪私自錄下保安細節欲監守自盜。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 倉狗泛指被飼養在貨倉、車房、回收場等地，用作看守門口的犬隻，牠們大多面對居住環境欠佳的問題。動物組織義工亮相「Kids’ Notes」，呼籲大眾關注倉狗的處境。義工希望為倉狗絕育，既能有效預防疾病，也有助控制流浪動物的數量。嘉賓分享在鄉郊推廣善待動物訊息的經驗，坦言初期遊說飼主讓倉狗絕育甚困難，更憶述曾到訪某倉庫，裡面竟住有逾二十隻倉狗。此外，嘉賓還呼籲有意飼養寵物的小朋友，宜向父母提出領養。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 金吾的劍術有退步跡象，戶部老師想一探究竟。金吾老實回答原因是故鄉遙遠，當他放假期間回鄉，一來一回已花光所有時間，無暇修煉劍術。但戶部不接受這個說法，還指責金吾諸多藉口，令他心情低落……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 茶果嶺有單位執修後再驗樓，客廳仍有「空心磚」，房間牆身有滲水痕跡，怎樣解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 大圍有單位地板經常濕滑，住戶懷疑與樓下24小時健身中心長開冷氣有關，向對方反映卻不果。「東張」介入後，中心一方願提供電費補助？某私人大廈女住戶長期囤積垃圾，天台、後樓梯、屋外都是其「貨倉地盤」！「雜物姐」於凌晨處理垃圾、佔用升降機運貨，引致環境衛生、噪音滋擾問題，鄰居大控訴！眾港姐佳麗為湖南之旅拍攝泳裝環節，獲師姐們模擬Q&A作熱身。國際龍舟邀請賽將於尖沙咀上演，節目搶先一覽嘉年華式的娛樂體驗。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2836粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵PG
programme.desc: 樹根故意延誤天台屋的維修工程，原來是想暫緩樹仁搬回來，避免他與城安「合體」後經常吵鬧，會對若水的BB產生不良影響。二人起初不以為然，及後卻發現自己的行為確實令一名小女孩受影響而「學壞」，遂決意改過，初時相敬如賓，不久又故態復萌。尚善嘗試令二人變得相親相愛，卻又引發其他問題。其後，虹豆沙湯遠以特別方法成功「馴服」二人，他們不再爭吵，若水卻察覺不妥，並嘗試「修復」二人關係……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#8粵
programme.desc: 人氣歌手Anson抵港，接機大堂聚集大批瘋狂粉絲，機場保安派出曾是Anson前隊友的成軒護送他……張穎陪同一名無成人陪伴的未成年旅客登機，卻得悉女孩的行李內藏違禁品，看似疏忽的背後，竟是女孩為了錯過航班的計劃……一艘抵港航班的數名乘客疑似出現食物中毒，機場立即啟動應急程序，安排醫護人員及救護車在停機坪提供支援。尚偉、啟光、可兒、張穎搭乘無人駕駛列車前往客運廊，列車突然停電，眾人被困於漆黑隧道內……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 倫敦的環球劇場，是莎士比亞不少劇目的首演場地。主持們由此「穿越」至莎翁的悲劇世界，拜訪尚未成名的莎翁，還有幸「演出」《哈姆雷特》。返回現實，二人前往與莎翁肖像塗鴉牆打卡，並搜購紀念品。參觀跟交通與工業歷史相關的博物館，翠如親手啟動古老的蒸汽機。彷彿開啟時光隧道，「參與」工業革命時代的蒸汽車比賽；再「見證」世上第一條載人鐵路的開幕禮。兩人還會隨技工維護並燃點煤氣燈，至今它們仍照亮倫敦市民的生活。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞等人打算落腳的三元村傳出茶園妖怪吃人之說，讓村民抗拒外人進村；此時遇上師兄孫幕卿和孫皓月，眾人才有安身之處。小松子撞破藥圃有人偷藥，翌早便被發現遇害；官差敷衍驗屍，秦莞不滿卻被小覷，直至燕遲現身…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
獵鷹#6粵PG
programme.desc: 大偉見戚幹線人蛋家文為道友，而他流連風月場所應酬，責戚幹以公事為名玩樂為實，戚幹多方解釋，但大偉不諒解。舞女蘭絲到警署痴纏大偉，累大偉被總警司警告。大偉為江霞製造機會，約戚幹到家中吃飯，江霞滿心歡喜，戚幹油然生出幸福之感。大偉掃蕩小電影架步，卻見嘉琦弟弟阿俊，遂把他放走，架步中人以為俊乃鬼頭仔，毆打他一頓。一帆約戚幹、大偉等回家吃飯，大偉在花園見一冷艷神秘女郎，心猿意馬，原來女郎乃一帆之妻康華。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#126粵
programme.desc: 根與花鬧翻後寄住朋家中，揚言不肯回家。朋發現根提到有一心願未了，便向花查問，根向朋要求朋助他開辦個人畫展，花利用「贈品」吸引客人，令畫展盛況空前。根滿足地回家，但卻不知眾人為他作出的巨大付出。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 謝危謀反逼宮，皇后姜雪寧自刎於寧安宮內，姜寧不願己作如此結尾，決定讓雪寧帶著記憶重來。雪寧回到尚未入宮之時，重生的她一反常態，用假帳本懲治惡僕討回財物，謝危看在眼裡，驚覺雪寧城府極深，遂派人前往監視。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵PG
programme.desc: 香港殿堂級歌手葉麗儀坐鎮節目，演繹多首代表作及《上海灘》系列劇集的三首主題曲，並與她的「最佳拍檔」葉振棠再度同台，順便重溫過去的合作演出。葉麗儀今次還與陸寶演繹歌曲，她與這位新拍檔又能擦出怎樣的火花？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#127粵
programme.desc: 眾人遇上多宗喜事，擔心是暴風雨前夕。露台突傳出巨響，樓上空置的單位突然有物件擲下，原來是有新房客遷入該址。新搬來的婆婆對眾人稱自己常遭虐待。眾人在藥房談論此事，但花聽後卻起了疑心，於是決定展開偵查。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 雪寧到尤府想找回前世的貼身宮女芳吟，發現她被家人壓制，雪寧奮不顧身營救。有刺客想刺殺謝危，雪寧剛好來到而被挾持，雪寧以為謝危想殺她。花燈會上，燕臨提到自己快將加冠，讓雪寧想起前世冠禮的情況而傷心落淚…

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 平民價煮出鵝肝味道，肥媽會以甚麼代替？芒果龍脷卷又會創出甚麼驚喜？怎樣煮出香滑的海鮮湯？她還傳授以平價錢吸收到可媲美大海魚的骨膠原。「大廚平煮」有黃君師傅示範賣相媲美一束鮮花的「囍愛嚐花」。

programme.title: 澳門「休」遊攻略粵
programme.desc: 喜歡前往澳門遊玩，但卻懶得規劃行程？相關巴士資訊網頁、澳門旅遊吉祥物「麥麥」帶路，讓「仙氣」女主持Rosita(郭柏妍)、游游(游嘉欣)輕鬆發掘當地的吃喝玩樂熱點，要「躺平」遊澳門，無問題！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 中醫學有句說話「久視傷血」，長期看屏幕、熬夜、飲食燥熱都可能是乾眼症的根源問題，而五臟六腑亦會將津液送到眼睛。醫師細談不同證型的症狀，並帶來有助改善乾眼症的穴位和茶飲建議。香港現行與棄養相關的法例未涉及爬蟲類、魚類，有心人見此特意創辦主力拯救被棄養烏龜的團體。他會述說救龜經歷，以及之後的處理程序，長遠盼望向社區推廣生命教育。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製酸甜菜式「西檸雞」，雞肉沾粉兩次又炸兩次有何作用？

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 曾參加《中年好聲音2》的陳寶雄試過糖尿上眼，自揭曾日飲七罐汽水，並藉訪談釐清不少人對糖尿病患者在飲食、醫療方面的誤解。另邊廂，永城請到內科醫生介紹兩款新型藥物。此外，如小便量多、易口渴、體重驟降，都是患糖尿病的先兆。糖尿病人要注意飲食，焗豬扒飯可免則免，營養師提議替代品，並簡述如何根據食品的升糖指數而控制血糖；中醫角度，則有茶療可降血糖。也有適合糖尿病人的運動動作，留意物理治療師與主持的示範。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#9粵PG

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「潰瘍性結腸炎」是炎症性腸病其中一種，腸胃肝臟科醫生指出，腸道微生態改變是誘發因素之一，此症會由直腸開始沿腸道往上蔓延。而治療目標是降低病人的發炎水平，病人務要準時服藥及定期檢查。一些錯誤使用隱形眼鏡的壞習慣，可能增加眼部感染風險，視光師細說正確戴隱形眼鏡的步驟，並需於戴前做好鏡片檢查。眼鏡度數不宜直接轉換成隱形眼鏡度數？戴後亦不宜閉眼小休？「睇餸食飯」，Annie用鯇魚煮出湖北傳統菜「糍粑魚」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 記性轉差？同一事情問完又問？有可能是認知障礙症先兆。永城接受相關AI系統測試；拍攝眼底影像、驗血，又是如何做到檢測患病風險？醫學院教授從全球調查報告結果，細說大多認知障礙患者的病因，並提出有助預防患病的日常生活錦囊。陳欣健的太太突然離家出走，令他察覺問題嚴重，求診後證實太太患上認知障礙症。病患受苦，照顧者或承受更大壓力，認知障礙協會代表帶來照顧者個案，提醒大家如遇照顧困難，肯揚聲必能找到舒緩出口。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 玲玲姐姐再次出任「Artspiration」的導師，並指導Emily姐姐繪畫葉子上的Q版蝸牛。而這回抽到的指定工具，是牙刷與潔面巾。潔面巾能為蝸牛殼印上獨特花紋，牙刷則可營造獨特的天氣效果，玲玲姐姐會怎樣落筆？「開心SHARE」在家裡最愛做的事，小朋友投稿分享自己喜歡在家練習編織、跳舞，也有孩子喜歡看書、玩陀螺。這亦勾起玲玲姐姐的學生回憶，她坦言自己不愛看書，但曾堅持花上一年時間看完一部武俠小說。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 看到小奈的成功，阿源開始思考如何自已容易緊張的問題，流星推介她嘗試吸動物的氣味。蜜柑為了拯救道場的生意，於是開始研發與功夫融合的舞蹈；她被邪音魔襲擊，幸好阿燎發現邪音魔的弱點並將其打敗。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵

programme.desc: 喜歡前往澳門遊玩，但卻懶得規劃行程？相關巴士資訊網頁、澳門旅遊吉祥物「麥麥」帶路，讓「仙氣」女主持Rosita(郭柏妍)、游游(游嘉欣)輕鬆發掘當地的吃喝玩樂熱點，要「躺平」遊澳門，無問題！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2838粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵PG
programme.desc: 熊家眾人對懷孕的若水百般遷就，她卻出現極大變化，仿如衍生多重人格，情緒化得難以「侍候」，眾人縱吃盡苦頭，亦只能默默承受。若水追看劇集，發現劇中懷孕妻子的丈夫疑似遭遇不測，預告片更出現丈夫喪禮的畫面。若水代入妻子角色，難過之餘，更擔心龔燁會遭遇不測。眾人設法安慰，城安查看下星期劇情預告，發現喪夫情節屬實，不敢讓若水知道。若水情緒低落，經常胡思亂想，龔燁務必在下集播出前設法改寫劇情……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#10粵
programme.desc: (大結局)一班客機於惡劣天氣降落時偏離跑道，北跑道被迫緊急關閉，尚偉、芷珊、雅雯等人迅速作出人流管制和航班編排，確保機場維持正常運轉的同時，也可盡快恢復跑道運行。尚偉被安排參與拍攝機場宣傳片，其生澀表現令人會心一笑。二副機師可兒迎來飛行生涯的重要考驗，在機長啟光嚴格監督下接受升級考試……「機場百年印記」展覽舉行，尚偉向記者闡述未來藍圖「SKYTOPIA」，展望每位員工都能在崗位上譜寫獨特篇章……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 翠如、永城「穿越回到」法國大革命的八月十日事件，更「親自」將路易十六送到敵對陣營並帶到斷頭台。巴黎作為甜品之都，他們走訪歷史悠久的麵包店，在路旁悠閒享用牛角酥與蘭姆巴巴，並介紹這些法式美點的由來故事。穿梭由現實與AI構建的巴黎聖母院，兩人「見證」拿破崙加冕一刻，再「隨」他奔赴戰場，助其贏下「三皇之戰」，並凱旋而歸。二人最後到訪名畫複製畫廊，這回無需AI協助，分別「化身」拿破崙畫像中的重要角色。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#10粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞休養期間，燕遲悉心照料，二人情感昇華。燕遲得知忠勇侯欲送侄女給裕王為妾，決赴豫州阻止，同時燕離也前往豫州主持裕王壽宴。燕遲在賓客名單上見李牧雲之名，憂秦莞失控。雙清班演出，清璃突然被楊英射中身亡…

獵鷹#8粵PG
programme.desc: 嘉琦責大偉鼓勵阿昇投考警察，大偉無奈離去。嘉琦弟妹無心向學，無一聽其勸告，獨自飲泣。蛋家文暗示增加線人費，戚幹與大偉商量卻被拒，爭執時被郭警司見到，著令戚幹放假。大偉於是安排他與江霞到外地旅遊。嘉慧久未返家，返回時遭嘉琦責打卻反唇相稽，嘉琦難受。大偉掃蕩陳水的白粉檔，陳水與國基商量帶走證人，國基假稱一直追查此案，說服大偉將案件轉交，隨即釋放證人。戚幹歸來知悉此事與大偉再生口角，被調到國基手下。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「潰瘍性結腸炎」是炎症性腸病其中一種，腸胃肝臟科醫生指出，腸道微生態改變是誘發因素之一，此症會由直腸開始沿腸道往上蔓延。而治療目標是降低病人的發炎水平，病人務要準時服藥及定期檢查。一些錯誤使用隱形眼鏡的壞習慣，可能增加眼部感染風險，視光師細說正確戴隱形眼鏡的步驟，並需於戴前做好鏡片檢查。眼鏡度數不宜直接轉換成隱形眼鏡度數？戴後亦不宜閉眼小休？「睇餸食飯」，Annie用鯇魚煮出湖北傳統菜「糍粑魚」。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#128粵
programme.desc: 情夢見化身成超級特工，醒後卻只處理瑣事。根訛稱自己是特務，收情為見習特務。可是，蘇根的所謂的「任務」，是要有情到後樓梯偷報紙，以及替蘇根打理家務。根更要情排隊換禮品，但因不良少女出現打翻蘇根如意算盤。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 雪寧列入芷衣伴讀名單，孟氏氣憤。薛遠欲給燕家偽造罪證，周寅之成功接近燕臨，雪寧猜到前世燕家慘案與寅之有關，提醒他別牽涉燕薛兩家之爭。雪寧在伴讀考試故意亂寫以求落選，不料謝危留她成為伴讀，她折返找謝危…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 做「女神」要有「仙氣」，數十年前追求女生則少不了「抄牌」和Call機！四位主持扮鬼扮馬，探究與戀愛相關的昔日俗語和現時潮語。「幣少」愛用「散紙」，無知店員竟以為其珍藏「一文不值」，且由鄭Sir趣談斗零、一蚊雞等貨幣的掌故歷史。「巴閉」本土味濃，詞語竟然來自印度！兩大食神以「揚州炒飯」、「京都骨」比拼廚藝，美食卻可能違反商品說明條例？眾人在順德大吃「正斗」陳村粉，廖Sir順道講解「陳村種」的由來。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 被列為「世界遺產」的開平碉樓，設計特別以作防禦土匪來襲。三名「老千」企圖侵吞碉樓，蕭博士如何藉着歷史知識揭破騙局？地產界術語別具創意，「吊臘鴨」、「BBQ」意即凶宅，「黑廁」、「油雞」又意何所指？翻看昔日售樓書，不設電梯竟是賣點！「火水哥」在求職中心得「女神」朱智賢提供就業輔導，期間帶出「吞泡」、「劈炮」等俗語的出處。看電影需要「解畫」、「戲橋」，多買座位只為「曬行頭」，鄭Sir細數當年睇戲文化。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生(完)
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 幽靈醫生(完)
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: The Glass House
programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: Monaco, a widowed inspector, too depressed to work, is forced get his act together when his own daughter becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a rich entrepreneur.

programme.title: I Was, I Am, I Will Be
programme.desc: Baran, a Kurdish gigolo seeking a better life in Europe meets Marion, a German pilot struggling with her cancer diagnosis. Entering into what was initially a sham marriage, the pair's relationship develops into something deeper.

programme.title: Being Mortal
programme.desc: Xia Tian relocates to her hometown to care for her dad, who suffered from Alzheimer for over a decade. She thought it would help her parents. However, as the disease worsens, she has to face the pressure of life. And the only thing she can do is to wait.

programme.title: Dad Got Grounded
programme.desc: Paul is a great pilot, but after breaking his promise to retire early to care for their son, his wife leaves him. Faced with having to take care of their son and his two other children by himself, Paul must show that he is a good father to win her back.

programme.title: Murder in Le Mans
programme.desc: An investigation ensues after the body of a Le Mans driver is discovered on the track just as the first trials of Le Mans race have just begun. Captain Sabrina Nedjard, assisted by an American officer from LAPD, heads the investigation.

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: Mara, a young Romanian mother, is a caretaker in the US on a temporary visa. Life seemed perfect after she got married and brought her son over. However, she faces abuses of power from the officer in her green card process, who seeks to exploit her plight.

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Cédric works in a company specialized in precision mechanics. Its management, run by an investment fund, is disastrous. As another fund is about to buy it again, Cédric decides to take the company over, giving it to the employees.

programme.title: Three Times Nothing
programme.desc: When three homeless friends win the lottery, they assume their lives are going to change drastically for the better. But claiming the money turns out to be more of a problem than a solution.

programme.title: Bluebird
programme.desc: In small town Maine, a school bus driver becomes distracted during her end-of-day inspection and fails to notice a sleeping boy in the back of the bus. What happens next shatters the tranquillity of her small logging town.

programme.title: Murder By Moonlight - EP2
programme.desc: Bella dan Julia tiba di hotel dengan identiti palsu. Pada masa yang sama, Ameera mula menyiasat kematian Tuan Osman. Di samping itu, Jit, Sangeetha dan Datuk Karnain juga sangat mencurigakan!

programme.title: Murder By Moonlight - EP3
programme.desc: Sangeetha mempunyai motif tetapi tidak ingat apa yang berlaku pada malam Tuan Osman meninggal. Semasa dia cuba ingat kembali, Ameera pula sedang mendalami penyiasatannya sendiri.

programme.title: Murder By Moonlight - EP4
programme.desc: Ben dan Mindy pergi ke dalam hutan untuk mencari seorang Penunggu? Dato Karnain dan Datin Saloma ikut untuk memastikan mereka tidak menipu.

programme.title: Perang Jantina - EP6

programme.title: Next To Neelofa - EP1

programme.title: Mael Lambong

This extraordinary moment in Earth's history took life to the brink, wreaking havoc and destruction on an unprecedented scale. But, somehow, life found a way to bounce back, and a new geological era ushered in the age of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: A Perfect Planet S01 - Oceans

programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Sleepover
programme.desc: A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Early Baby
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek. Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Smooth Coated Otters
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Singapore on a global adventure to help guide a smooth-coated otter family back to the safety of a nearby river.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Hippos
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to explore the Okavango Delta in Botswana, Africa, in search of hippos. Along the way, Andy meets a giraffe, hitches a ride with an oxpecker and gets stuck in the mud with fighting hippos.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial world's greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gang's hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial world's greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gang's hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal…

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancée before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic "The Water Margin", and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora's Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.
